sections.title: Link weather to routine
sections.content: Use weather expressions with familiar activities to say what you do in different weather.

sections.title: Weather + routine
rows: When it is sunny, I walk.
When it is hot, I drink water.
When it rains, I study at home.
When it is cold, I work at home.
Cuando hace frío, trabajo en casa.

items.spanish: Cuando hace sol, voy al parque.
items.english: When it is sunny, I go to the park.
When it rains, I study at home.
When it is hot, I drink water.

sections.content: Cuando introduces a condition or situation. Keep the activity in the familiar present tense: Cuando llueve, estudio.
